M1.change: evaluate_endedness no longer accepts a union. New signature evaluate_endedness(request, read_bytes, census_log, identities, deadline_check). It REBUILDS the union from the frozen parent-captured histories in request via the same in-module builder (_build_union, which build_identity_union also wraps), using a separate _Io. Verdict inputs are only the rebuilt report and the census transaction: rebuilt state must be CLOSED_CONDITIONAL with causes [] (else E_UNION_HELD); a CLOSED rebuilt report listing any unknown incarnation is E_UNION_UNKNOWN (defensive; the builder's sticky rule already prevents it); spec identities must typed-equal the rebuilt prt_identities (else E_IDENTITIES_MISMATCH). Module/design-freeze/scheme/producer/digest fields are informational outputs, never inputs. _union_version, _v_union and spec_identities_match are removed (no caller-supplied union is ever trusted). Result echoes the REBUILT union_sha256 so CP1 can compare it with the union it used before PRT.
M1.load_bearing: ENDED requires the rebuild from captured history bytes plus typed equality with the PRT identities; no self-attested field participates in the decision.

M2.boundary: Prevents accidental fabrication and cross-transaction substitution only; NOT protection against an adversarial same-process caller (no cryptography). Parent code/builder/reader provenance stays the explicit condition PARENT_CODE_PROVENANCE.
M2.change: make_census(deadline_check) keeps its signature but issues a CensusLog HANDLE (not publicly constructible into an accepted state; slots only) whose state lives in a module-private weakref registry: call counter, in-flight flag, sealed flag, immutable canonical-byte journal (attempt_start, attempt_end, served, refusal entries with seq numbers) and a SHA-256 chain over the journal. One census call per factory (a second call is refused). evaluate_endedness looks the handle up (E_CENSUS_LOG_FOREIGN), seals it before anything else and requires no call in flight and exactly calls=1, served=1, refusals=0 (E_CENSUS_TRANSACTION; second evaluation refused), then re-validates chain, entry order/canonical form, schemas, attempt sequence and statuses, counts (listed = identified + missing, process_count), missing sample, per-row and rows digests, observer pid = factory pid, observer bracket coverage recomputed, completeness recomputed, finite observed_at_mono and the digest of the served dict rebuilt from rows (E_CENSUS_EVIDENCE_INVALID). Processes are evaluated only after all of that passes.

M3.change: _baseline returns (baseline, completion) and requires a complete prespawn baseline WITNESS from recorded sv19 evidence: the leading attempts of observation_attempts that are kind identity_scan, phase ADMISSION, inside_helper False (the establish_baseline loop) number 1..3; each has aborted False, error None, finite ordered window; every one but the last has a coverage stamp inside its window and the last has none (a non-finite stamp counts as a gap everywhere); no identity observation straddles the last scan window; every observation inside it is unflagged; and the SET OF UNIQUEIDS OBSERVED INSIDE THE LAST SCAN WINDOW EQUALS the recorded baseline_uniqueids with exactly one observation per uid and identified_count equal. ACK: receipt baseline event_refs lie inside that window and receipt baseline.mono_complete >= scan end; completion = receipt mono_complete, else scan end. New cause U_BASELINE_CHRONOLOGY: every helper report mono_spawn finite and > completion; the main child (main_wait non-null) needs the RECORDED receipt mono_spawn > completion (refusal histories carry no recorded main spawn time and stay HELD); no spawned identity (helper, main child) is a baseline uid. Skipped when the ACK receipt binding failed (already HELD).
M3.equality_set: recorded reconciliation baseline_uniqueids == {uniqueid of every raw tape observation inside the last leading ADMISSION identity-scan window}; NOT the last-census window.
M3.natural_endings: The baseline set is fixed by the prespawn scan. A pre-existing (baseline) process that ends naturally stays a baseline identity: it never becomes a member, its pid/pgid never become historical member pids/pgids, and the last-census rule stays inside(L) subset-of baseline with exact cardinality, so its absence is neither an error nor a reclassification. A process born later cannot enter the baseline set because the set must equal the prespawn scan window, and run-owned processes descend from spawns recorded after that scan. An unrelated new process alive at the last census has a non-baseline uid and HOLDs (U_LAST_CENSUS_OPEN), never silently baseline.
M3.time_witnesses: Only recorded sv19 monotonic values are used: scan attempt mono_start/mono_end, coverage stamps, tape observation intervals, receipt baseline.mono_complete, helper mono_spawn, receipt main mono_spawn. No spawn/exit time is inferred or synthesized; a spawn without a recorded time is U_BASELINE_CHRONOLOGY.

M4.change: New _native(deadline_check, stage, pid, function, *args, **kwargs): ORIGINAL deadline immediately before and after ONE native acquisition; on failure the completion check still runs and a failing check raises with the primary as __context__, else the primary is re-raised. Applied to ctypes.CDLL, each dlsym attribute lookup, os.getpid (factory and observer), each of the five proc_pidinfo calls in _identify, proc_listallpids sizing and every fill call, time.sleep and time.monotonic. _Io.read now also runs its completion tick on the read_bytes BaseException branch, then re-raises the primary.

M5.change: evaluate_endedness: final original-deadline check AFTER the complete result is constructed and canonically hashed; failure fires E_DEADLINE and reassembles a HELD result with no further callback. build_identity_union keeps its post-assembly check. The census callback runs its final check after assembling the served record and before journaling/returning it.

M6.change: Endedness result assembly + hashing inside an ordinary-Exception boundary; on failure E_INTERNAL_ERROR and a minimal HELD result built only from module constants, cause names, validated union digest and counters; never raises Exception. BaseException propagates with exc.parent_release_endedness_partial (causes + bounded callback log).

m7.change: _sticky never raises; it appends a detail (each firing U_UNKNOWN_INCARNATION) for: every pending raw/overflow row; raw_acquisitions not a list of dicts; history_halted not False or history_overflow not None; overflow not a dict; an overflow completed observation that is not a dict with an identity dict; coverage_history not a list or an entry without a 3-list observation; every coverage gap; helper reports not a list or a report without an identity key; every identity-less helper; main_wait with null main_identity.

m8.change: Each census attempt journals attempt_start before any acquisition and exactly one attempt_end on every exit: COMPLETE/INCOMPLETE with listed/identified/missing/observer/rows digest, or ABORTED with bounded partial evidence (identified count, partial rows digest, missing sample <=64, last pid attempted, observer pid, error text or BaseException type); the census call journals a refusal entry on every exceptional exit.

m9.change: Controls: C36 split into C36a (same main history twice: [U_FAMILY_INVALID]) and C36b (two distinct main drivers: [U_FAMILY_INVALID, U_ROW_CONFLICT]); N01 exact ordered causes derived from its fixture rows: [E_UNION_HELD, E_MEMBER_ALIVE, E_GROUP_NONEMPTY] for a childless setsid escapee still in its recorded group.
